name: The Endless Argument
codex: Every answer bounces back with a louder question.

name: Pyre of the Faithful
codex: Pyra's congregation arrives all at once.

name: The Hungry Orbit
codex: Four blades, one appetite.

name: Event Horizon
codex: Nothing escapes a shot that wants you.

name: Colossus Doctrine
codex: Valdris's first commandment: through them.

name: The Thunder Ledger
codex: Every debt to Zephyros is paid in lightning.

name: The Plague Gardener
codex: Plant widely. Water with rot.

name: Judgment Day
codex: The verdict passes through the whole line.

name: Wildfire Contract
codex: Mirren's favorite clause: the fire spreads and so does the profit.

name: The Vein Tap
codex: Every wound opens two more.

name: Sunspike Sermon
codex: A sermon best delivered at point-blank range.

name: The Nightmare Ledger
codex: Nyctia keeps accounts. You are overdrawn.

name: Conductor's Requiem
bonus: Chain(jumps: 1, range: 4.0, falloff: 0.7); ApplyStatus(status: Shock, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 2.0)
codex: The sky conducts, the horde performs, and nobody survives to applaud.

name: The Crowded Grave
codex: Pull them close, bury them together. It saves on shovels.

name: Compound Interest
codex: Every coin comes back, and it brings friends.

name: Writ of Execution
bonus: DamageVsStatus(status: Mark, mult: 1.15); ApplyStatus(status: Mark, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0)
codex: Signed in light, sealed in gold, served at the speed of law.

name: Gaiaa's Gallows
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Root, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 1.5); Damage(1.08)
codex: The earth holds them still so that you can be thorough.

name: One Shot, One Grave
codex: Ossian only ever needed one shot. The rest were for the audience.

name: The Godsbane Oath
codex: It killed a god once. It would very much like to do it again.

name: Whip of the Heavens
codex: Selene cracked it once. The horde is still flinching.

name: Nyctia's Wager
codex: Nyctia plays with crooked bones and loaded dice. So do you, and the house is losing.

name: The Arsenal Wakes
codex: Every loosed arrow drafts another archer. Thessaly calls it recruitment.

name: The Kiln Mouth
codex: The forge exhales, and the floor becomes the forge.

name: The Red Reaping
bonus: Lifesteal(0.02); ApplyStatus(status: Bleed, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 3.0)
codex: Gaiaa's blood-law: what you spill, you keep.

name: Pyra's Fireworks
bonus: Area(1.1); ApplyStatus(status: Burn, chance: 0.2, stacks: 1, duration: 3.0)
codex: Pyra loved a celebration, especially somebody else's funeral.

name: The Thundering Heads
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Shock, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 2.0); Damage(1.05)
codex: Three more heads, one storm, and a horde with nowhere left to run.

name: The Final Hour
codex: Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. Boom.

name: The Long Mercy
codex: Mercy is a long blade and a short queue.

name: The Anvil Waltz
codex: Brax learned to dance. The floor did not survive the lesson.

name: The Seraphic Schism
codex: The light finds you, then argues with itself over how many ways to end you.

name: The Kindling Doctrine
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Burn, chance: 0.15, stacks: 1, duration: 3.0); Damage(1.05)
codex: Pyra's first law: what burns, burns more. Her second law is the first law, louder.

name: Litany of Lightning
codex: Every bounce a verse, every arc an amen. The congregation does not stay for the sermon.

name: Hound-9's Litter
codex: Hound-9 insists they are not puppies. They are absolutely puppies, and every one is armed.

name: The Tolling Hour
codex: Five hits, one funeral. Do the arithmetic, then start digging.

name: One Foot in the Pyre
codex: Umbra-Rex's favourite stance: one foot in the grave, the other on the horde's neck.

name: The Smiting Line
codex: Seraphel never raised her voice. She raised a line of light, and the line was final.

name: Murmuration of Murrain
codex: A flock of sickness. It knows where the horde lives.

name: Morwenn's Undertow
codex: Behind every shot runs a sick tide. Morwenn calls it the scenic route.

name: Quagmire Liturgy
codex: Gravemaw spits, the ground swallows, and the horde learns to stand still forever.

name: The Bleeding Halo
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Bleed, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 3.0); MoveSpeed(1.05)
codex: Stand still and they circle. Run and they circle faster. Someone is bleeding, and it is not you.

name: The Unending Refrain
codex: You fire once. The Forge keeps singing it back.

name: Clockwork Heresy
codex: Epoch wound a dead god's clock backwards to see what would happen. This happened.

name: Accounts Receivable
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Curse, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0); Damage(1.05)
codex: Every curse is a line item, and Thessaly always collects.

name: Rose of Cinders
codex: Round and round the firework goes. Where it stops, nobody is left to say.

name: The Shrapnel Gospel
codex: Five pellets, twenty fragments, one very brief sermon.

name: Foundry Rain
codex: The Slag King fell, and it has been raining him ever since.

name: The Blightburn Accord
bonus: Puddle(radius: 1.0, duration: 1.5, dps: 0.1, status: Burn); Damage(1.05)
codex: Rot and fire signed a treaty. The horde was not consulted.

name: The Branching Sky
codex: Lightning never strikes the same place twice. It prefers five places at once.

name: The Drowning Dark
codex: The harpoon pulls them in, the well keeps them, and the sea keeps everything.

name: The Turning Spheres
codex: The planets never stop. Neither do the discs. Neither, briefly, does the screaming.

name: The Mountain's Bloom
codex: Valdris stood in the middle of the horde and simply went off.

name: The Unbroken Anvil
codex: Valdris has been hit by gods. He describes it as a firm handshake.

name: The Cinder Stampede
codex: Kael dashes to survive. You dash because the floor catches fire and it is funny.

name: The Wandering Wicks
codex: They drift and they circle, setting the whole field alight in search of someone to hug.

name: Heaven's Battery
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Shock, chance: 0.1, stacks: 1, duration: 2.0); UltCharge(1.1)
codex: Selene stores lightning in the horde and withdraws it with interest.

name: Orbit of the Unmade
codex: A ring of little voids around you. They are not hungry. They are starving.

name: Morwenn's Breath
codex: The sea-goddess sighed once and a coastline died. Your breath is smaller. Slightly.

name: The Gilded Bastion
codex: Seraphel's law protects the faithful. The faithful are, in this case, heavily armed.

name: The Law of Large Numbers
codex: Statistically, one of them was going to explode. Statistically, it was all of them.

name: Twice-Cursed
codex: Thessaly signed the curse twice, just to be sure. The horde was sure.

name: The First Word
codex: Seraphel calls it an introduction. The horde never gets to reply.

name: Double or Nothing
codex: Mirren never gambles. Mirren shoots twice and calls it insurance.

name: The Narrow Sun
codex: Seven pellets, one hole, no survivors.

name: The Crows' Tithe
codex: The crows always take their share. Mirren is negotiating a commission.

name: Burning the Candle
codex: At both ends, then the middle, then the candlestick.

name: The Titanfeller's Draw
codex: The Last Titan is very large. That is not a problem. That is a target.

name: The Serpent's Thirst
codex: The serpent drinks one sip at a time. It never stops drinking.

name: The Reddeath Reaction
codex: Vex calls it chemistry. Everyone else calls it the reason the room is gone.

name: The Pack Remembers
codex: Fenra's pack does not hunt gods. It hunts what the gods were afraid of.

name: The Last Chorus
codex: Lyra sings the final verse of a hymn no god lived to hear.

name: Chaos Theorem
codex: It split, it bounced, it split again. The Unmaking took notes.

name: The Heir's Verdict
bonus: ApplyStatus(status: Mark, chance: 0.15, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0); Damage(1.05)
codex: Seraph reads the charges. The carbine reads the sentence.
